index.sub: Claude Code skills for social media *and* short-form video — the whole pipeline, from the interview to a rendered file — plus a hosted MCP server. Side quests from the team building SocialGPT. MIT-licensed. No waitlist, no gate: clone and go.

skills.sub: Sixteen installable skills: the cultural literacy of the feed — reading tone, dissecting hooks, timing trends, speaking each platform's dialect — plus the craft of *making* one. Deep coverage of Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube; X and LinkedIn too. Eight of the sixteen need nothing installed; the video engine now lives in the same repo, one `pip install` away — [what each layer gives you](#boundary).

mcp.sub: One URL connects your SocialGPT analytics, video analysis, and content intelligence to any agent that speaks MCP. Nothing to install, no API keys: OAuth 2.1 with PKCE, read-only by default, revoke any time.
